Run a complete self-assessment of the iterative update mechanism:

1. Compute all metrics from the iteration log (error resolution rate, user needs automated, architecture reviews, task planning accuracy, mechanism health)
2. Compare each metric to the last assessment in metrics.md
3. Identify any metric that degraded or is below target
4. For each underperforming area, propose and apply a specific improvement
5. Update metrics.md with the new assessment
6. Set the next assessment due date to 2 weeks from now
7. Log the assessment in the iteration log
